meta: - type: "problem" - docs.description: "Require @story and @req annotations on code branches" - messages.missingAnnotation: "Branch is missing required annotation: {{missing}}." - schema: options object with array `branchTypes` (uniqueItems, additionalProperties: false). - create(context): - Calls validateBranchTypes(context) from ../utils/branch-annotation-helpers. - If validateBranchTypes returns a listener (invalid config), returns it directly (configuration error reporting path). - Otherwise, iterates the resulting branchTypes and configures a handler per type that calls reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef), skipping SwitchCase with null test (default case).,Branch utilities implementation: src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES (JSDoc @req REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA): ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase", "TryStatement", "CatchClause", "ForStatement", "ForOfStatement", "ForInStatement", "WhileStatement", "DoWhileStatement"]. - validateBranchTypes(context) (JSDoc @req REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE): - Reads context.options[0] || {}. - If options.branchTypes is an array: - Filters invalid types via DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.includes. - If invalidTypes.length > 0: - Returns { Program(node) { invalidTypes.forEach(reportInvalidType) } }. - reportInvalidType(t) calls context.report with message: `Value "${t}" should be equal to one of the allowed values: ${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.join(", ")}`. - If no invalidTypes, returns options.branchTypes as BranchType[]. - If branchTypes not provided, returns Array.from(DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES). - gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node) (JSDoc @req REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION): - For SwitchCase: scans up to PRE_COMMENT_OFFSET lines above node.loc.start.line while lines match /^\s*(\/\/|\/\*)/, collecting and joining them. - For other nodes: uses sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node) and joins comment.value strings. - reportMissingStory(...) and reportMissingReq(...) (JSDoc @req REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING): - Decide whether to offer an autofix based on storyFixCountRef.count (for @story) or missingStory (for @req). - If autofix, use fixer.insertTextBeforeRange to insert `// @story .story.md` or `// @req ` with correct indentation. - Always report ESLint problem with messageId: "missingAnnotation" and data { missing: "@story" | "@req" }. - reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef) (JSDoc @req REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING): - text = gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node). - missingStory = !/@story\b/.test(text), missingReq = !/@req\b/.test(text). - Determines indent from sourceCode.lines[node.loc.start.line - 1] and insertPos via getIndexFromLoc. - traceability.notes:
Story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS is fully implemented.
All key acceptance criteria are met: - Core Functionality (branch detection & annotation enforcement): The require-branch-annotation rule and branch-annotation-helpers utilities detect all specified significant branches (if/else, try/catch, switch cases, loops) and enforce presence of both @story and @req annotations by inspecting preceding comments. Missing annotations are reported with a clear, parameterized message and, where appropriate, auto-fixers insert default annotations. - Quality & Integration: The rule is structured as a standard ESLint RuleModule with meta, schema, and messages; it uses helper utilities, follows ESLint patterns, and is wired into the plugin’s rules and recommended/strict configs. Behavior works correctly across nested and complex control flow because it relies on ESLint’s AST traversal and is purely node-local. - User Experience & Error Handling: Error messages clearly indicate which annotation is missing. Configuration errors (invalid branchTypes) are reported via a Program listener with an informative message listing allowed values, matching the invalid-configuration behavior described in the story. Tests assert both missing-annotation behavior and config error messages. - Documentation: docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md documents the rule’s purpose, configuration, examples of correct/incorrect code, and invalid configuration behavior, and is explicitly tied to this story and its requirements. - Configurable Scope & Performance: The validateBranchTypes helper implements configuration of which branch types to enforce and validates configuration efficiently. The overall design (single-pass AST visitors, simple string/regex checks) is suitable for large files and aligns with the performance and configurability requirements.
Given the concrete implementation, comprehensive tests, documentation, and plugin integration, the story’s acceptance criteria and definition of done are satisfied.
